layers.process: Augrabies Falls National Park: SANParks lists gate hours 07:00–18:30 all year. Although the gate is staffed around the clock, arrange arrival after 18:30 or departure before 07:00 in advance with the park. Confirm current times.

Kgalagadi: SANParks identifies Twee Rivieren as the South African gate, Mata-Mata as the Namibian gate, and Two Rivers, Mabuasehube and Kaa as Botswana gates. A passport is needed for departure through a different gate into another country; Namibian immigration also asks day visitors to show passports. Check border formalities and gate times before travel.

Mokala: the main gates are not staffed around the clock. Guests staying at the Tree House, Motswedi campsite or Haak-en-Steek must check in at reception at least one hour before main gate closure. Rain can close internal roads, including the route between Mosu Lodge and Lilydale; confirm current access with the park.
